title: Oak2Spruce
description: "Oak2Spruce" is a texture pack that swaps the textures of oak and spruce logs and wood.
body:
Oak2Spruce is a texture pack developed as a lighthearted side project, originally created out of boredom. It swaps the textures of oak and spruce wood to offer a fun twist for players looking to troll friends or just dont like the textures of logs i guess??

**Here are the features of the texturepack**

![Picture of the texture pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c3ec6f6d21a3114d3da8dfb4c284978696404b81.png)

**1. Spruce logs/wood now look like Oak logs/wood**

**2. Oak logs/wood now look like Spruce logs/wood**

**3. The Textures of Spruce and Oak logs/wood are now swapped**
   
**4. The Textures of Spruce and Oak logs/wood are now swapped for trolling your friends or just a fun challenge!**
